docs.text: sales_dip_recovery_promo template (channel: WhatsApp Business API, trigger: weekday_sales_dip_detected): "Hi {customer_name}! 👋 {merchant_name} misses you. Enjoy {discount_pct}% off on {item_name} this week only. Visit us or reply to this message to reserve yours. Valid till {expiry_date}.". Guardrails: discount_pct must not exceed merchant's configured max_discount_pct (default 15%); max 1 promo per customer per 14 days.

restock_reminder_to_merchant template (channel: Paytm Merchant App notification, trigger: low_stock_detected): "{item_name} is running low ({stock_qty} left, sells ~{avg_daily_units}/day). Reorder now to avoid a stockout in ~{days_to_stockout} days.". Guardrails: none specified.

loan_eligibility_nudge template (channel: Paytm Merchant App + AI Soundbox voice prompt, trigger: lending_eligibility_confirmed): "Based on your last {lookback_months} months of settlements, you're pre-approved for a working capital loan of up to ₹{max_loan_inr} at {interest_rate}% for {tenure_months} months. Tap to apply — no paperwork needed.". Guardrails: Never shown more than once per 30 days to the same merchant; Requires explicit one-tap consent before any application is submitted.
